banners.prompt:
The FIRST input image is only a blank canvas. The SECOND input image shows the printed book (style, colours and dogs reference only).
Create a square product image on a pure WHITE background with a soft shadow: a modern tablet standing slightly angled, filling about 70% of the frame, showing a PDF guide cover on screen: a happy dog looking at a plate of homemade dog biscuits and treats, dark teal title area with no readable text. A big orange rounded label at the top of the image.
TEXT (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Label at the top: "КУЧЕШКА КУХНЯ"
STYLE: premium, warm, friendly, modern; clean professional product photo like a bestselling publisher would use. Palette of the book: dark teal #0E3B43, warm orange #F28C28, light mint #E3F4EE and white.
The image will be shown very small (about 82x82 px), so the product and its label must be HUGE and the composition very simple.
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic. Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character. Do not translate, correct, shorten or add any words.
- Heavy, clean sans-serif with full Cyrillic (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black style).
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices or website addresses anywhere.
DOGS: ordinary friendly family dogs, natural anatomy. NO people, no faces; if a hand appears it is gender-neutral.
